description: This file defines the 'Task' class within the OpenCart admin startup controller namespace. It manages scheduling and starting background tasks, particularly by registering shutdown functions and executing command-line task runners.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing task execution and scheduling in the admin startup process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Registers a shutdown function to invoke the task start process unless running via CLI.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts processing of queued tasks if not already running, utilizing system commands appropriate for the operating system.
